'''Matthew Kucklinca''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2000 New York City tournament]] on 13 February 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Lone Warrior Ralltiir Ops]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d253">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-14-nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00d253/ nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 14 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-14-nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00d253/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
